tools.name: check_exclusions
tools.description: Check 1 to 20 identities against a dated active SAM snapshot. Pass identities as an array of objects, not a record ID or page URL. Each identity needs a name, UEI, CAGE, or NPI. Exact identifier matches and name-only possible matches remain distinct. Read coverage.freshness; stale or unknown-source

tools.name: detail
tools.description: Retrieve a public record using the exact collection and id returned by search, never a page URL, title or slug. Supply the returned generation for a consistent result.

tools.name: document
tools.description: Read official record text using the exact collection, id and generation returned by search. Start at offset 0 with length 1 to 16,000 characters, then use next_offset unchanged for the next chunk. Does not fetch arbitrary URLs or paths.

tools.name: exclusion_changes
tools.description: Compare two retained snapshots. No longer observed does not mean reinstated; enrichment-only changes are excluded.

tools.name: exclusion_context
tools.description: Retrieve an exclusion with agency explanation, named restriction references, source evidence, explicit source-age warnings and supported business links.

tools.name: explain_match
tools.description: Explain deterministic primary NAICS overlap between a registered vendor and opportunity. Not an eligibility determination.

tools.name: freshness
tools.description: Report actual source dates, coverage, record counts and SHA256 provenance.

tools.name: research_opportunity
tools.description: Build a cited research brief with retained notice requirements, exact award-number candidates and same-industry comparisons. Does not infer an incumbent or eligibility.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public opportunities, vendors, awards, exclusions, or reference collections. Results include provenance and a generation-pinned cursor.

tools.name: search_exclusions
tools.description: Filter active exclusion records by agency, program, classification, geography and dates. Limit is a maximum; large records can produce a smaller page with page_size_limited true. Continue with next_cursor and unchanged filters and limit. Preserve generation and read coverage.freshness for source age

tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Find official opportunity records by keywords, industry, set-aside, state, agency and source status. Active does not imply the deadline is open.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
